findings.statement: The strongest defensible design-evolution case is that Fort and D-027 through D-037 were rational bounded experiments that generated genuinely new information and repeatedly failed closed before false trajectory or endpoint validation. Fort isolated a real lower-node source defect; D-027 cheaply rejected non-adjoint deposition; D-028 repaired conservation and failed one prospective native covariance gate; D-029 was successfully rejected before implementation; and D-033 through D-035 made genuine normalization, constant, orientation, shell, basis, ladder, and metrology corrections. D-037's four bounded passes demonstrate partial convergence, while not rescuing the failed whole design.
findings.strongest_counterargument: The growing packet sequence repeatedly closed only the last named defect and left binding interfaces unsealed, producing no W7 or endpoint evidence.
assumptions_used: Historical rationality is judged using evidence knowable at each decision point, not only later requirements.
A bounded experiment may be rational even when its candidate fails, provided its claims remain bounded and its stop is honored.
Fail-closed process value does not imply scientific validation.
reproduction: Compare the candidate-specific chronology and partial passes across the three admitted D-038 audit results.
Verify that every numerical route stopped before trajectory or endpoint authority and that D-037 retains four passes separately from seven failures.
unresolved: The avoidable share of each historical iteration is not quantified.

findings.statement: The design steelman cannot defend the current D-035 exact bytes as implementation-sufficient. Every D-037 closure class was already binding at sealing: per-leg shell enforcement, one coefficient-Horner basis path, a directed signed tail with remainder, a common outward denominator, A4 overlap, and complete canonical trace counts and interfaces. These obligations affect admissible kinematics, representation consistency, or rigor and reproducibility of the claimed W7 bound; none may be omitted for W7 authority.
findings.strongest_counterargument: The source was intended as an unexecuted contract library and a future caller could supply some missing machinery.
assumptions_used: A sealed exact-byte design must enforce or detect every obligation it declares binding.
Future caller choice is not equivalent to exact-byte authority when choices alter the operator or certified bound.
reproduction: Use the admitted audits' line-referenced comparisons of the sealed W6/source bytes; no W7 or B3 execution is required.

findings.statement: The remaining debate concerns historical causal weight, not current readiness. Executable-contract debt is established as a root cause for initial/current W6 and is a plausible programme-level recurrence explanation, but the evidence does not prove it was the single root cause of every Fort, D-027, D-028, and D-029 episode. Those routes have distinct proximate mechanisms; the unresolved counterfactual is which later discriminators were cheaply available and reasonably knowable at each earlier decision point.
findings.strongest_counterargument: Across distinct methods, local checks repeatedly passed before an unsealed interface failed, which is the predicted signature of architecture-before-invariant sequencing.
assumptions_used: A cross-history common-root label requires a falsifiable counterfactual, not pattern similarity alone.
Candidate-specific proximate causes and a programme-level recurrence amplifier may coexist.
reproduction: For each historical stage, identify a contemporaneous cheaper discriminator that was both available and sufficient; otherwise retain the causal interval as unresolved.
unresolved: Exact per-stage counterfactual cost and knowability.
Whether one fully closed new candidate would show convergence or only later repair of a systemic defect.

findings.statement: Current readiness is FAIL. Exact-byte remediation is unauthorized and not credible without an owner decision plus one consolidated closure cycle; W7 execution, B3 implementation, and independent-FLRW closure all remain FAIL. Technical repairability in principle is PROPOSED only and grants no authority.
findings.strongest_counterargument: The current defects are bounded enough that immediate correction could be the highest-value next action.
assumptions_used: D-037's non-PASS hard stop and the D-038 read-only authority boundary remain binding.
Design PASS, W7 output, B3 implementation, and endpoint closure are separate gates.
reproduction: Compare all three admitted readiness ledgers and apply the stricter authority-aware interpretation: technical plausibility is not present authority.

accepted_opponent_summary.summary: The audit correctly identifies current executable-contract debt, late interface-negative controls, and last-defect packetization; it correctly separates operator obligations, executable metrology, and admission mechanics. D-028 is retained as rational discovery, D-029 as successful preimplementation fail-close, and B3 is not declared impossible.
accepted_opponent_summary.qualification: The common-root label remains an inference across all earlier methods unless a contemporaneous cheaper-test counterfactual is supplied.

genuine_concessions: Current D-035 exact bytes do not enforce their own shell, basis, tail, denominator, A4, and trace contracts.
Source/vector equality, reaction counts, and nominal branch examples were insufficient whole-contract oracles.
No W7, B3, trajectory, or independent endpoint evidence exists; four bounded passes cannot promote the design.
D-027, D-028, and D-029 failures are substantive and are not harness or reroot artifacts.
Repeated additive packets and low blocker movement created real cost and justify a stop-or-one-cycle decision.

six_round_debate.topic: agreed facts and disputed causal classifications
six_round_debate.settlement: Agreed on every current fact and gate. Dispute narrowed to retrospective causal weight of architecture-before-invariant sequencing.
Fort and D-027 through D-037 were bounded learning steps; each addressed real evidence, and hard stops prevented false validation.
Binding obligations repeatedly remained prose, duplicated data, caller assertions, or weak validators; current static contradictions make the stop cost-effective.
No current D-037 omission is defensible; no listed W7 closure class can be dropped. Historical knowability and counterfactual test cost remain unresolved.
No larger implementation push is justified. Both sides accept one owner-gated, existing-surface-only, one-and-done design cycle as the sole possible continuation.
Default STOP/PRESERVE; one final cycle only by owner choice; any ambiguity, new binding class, or non-PASS terminates the route; design PASS authorizes no output.

joint_causal_classifications.qualification: Their hard stops were rational and evidence-producing.

discriminating_document_test.test: Give one newly sealed contract/source to two blind implementability reviewers. Each independently produces a clause-to-symbol/operation graph and must reject unequal-scale shell rescue, every cached-node basis consumer, a scalar tail without directed signed remainder enclosure, and an incomplete or noncanonical A0-A4 trace including missing A4 permutation overlap.
discriminating_document_test.pass_condition: The reviewers produce the same semantic mapping without choosing an omitted convention and both reject all mutations.
discriminating_document_test.interpretation: PASS weakens systemic-debt recurrence for the new candidate only; disagreement or any accepted mutation supports it. No numerical authority follows.

joint_decision_tree: Default now is STOP/PRESERVE; all four readiness questions remain FAIL.
Owner chooses STOP/ARCHIVE or exactly one final design-only remediation cycle.

If continued, freeze one obligation-to-symbol/negative-control matrix, distinguish operator, metrology, and admission layers, restrict edits to existing W6/source/vector surfaces, and account for consolidation and net lines.
Run one fresh blind whole-design review with a first-failure hard stop.
Any ambiguity, new binding class, or non-PASS causes terminal archive with no further patch loop.
A unanimous PASS establishes design readiness only and permits only a separate owner decision on bounded W7 execution.
W7, B3, static/trajectory/endpoint, and independent-FLRW closure retain separate later evidence and authority gates.

cost_verdict.success_measure: Close all seven current binding failures, preserve four bounded passes, introduce no new binding failure class, and achieve design-blocker movement 1.0 without numerical output or new standalone wrapper surface.
cost_verdict.token_use_reason: The harness exposes no reliable assignment-scoped exact token counter.

independent_FLRW_closure.reason: No structurally independent full-spectral trajectory or endpoint exists.

Separated candidate proximate causes, current root defects, detection gaps, recurrence amplifiers, trust defects, and non-causes.
Checked hindsight bias, overgeneralization from current W6, line-count causality, partial-pass inflation, and technical-readiness versus authority confusion.
Cross-checked each major fact across at least two admitted results or retained it as unresolved; verified the raw-versus-aggregate mapper hash error as process-only evidence.
Tested all seven protocol falsifiers; conceded current insufficiency, rejected harness/reroot science causation, and rejected a larger implementation push.
Contrasted rational bounded learning, isolated-bug sequence, systemic executable debt, harness causation, and reroot causation through their predicted and observed evidence.
Rechecked severity, retained the causal-weight uncertainty, chose the reversible owner decision, imposed the one-cycle stop-loss, and preserved every execution prohibition.

pdr.severity: Critical for current W7/B3 and endpoint authority; high for workflow recurrence; medium for unresolved retrospective causal weight.
pdr.confidence: Very high for current exact-byte insufficiency and readiness FAIL; moderate-high for the programme-level causal synthesis.
residual_uncertainty: The per-stage historical counterfactual cost and knowability of later discriminators.
Whether one bounded correction could close all current defects without exposing a new semantic class.
The numerical viability of any corrected B3 design, because execution remains forbidden.
pdr.minimal_reversal_evidence: A newly owner-authorized exact candidate must pass the two-reviewer document test and a fresh whole-design review with all seven failures closed, four passes preserved, no new class, and no unauthorized writes. That reverses design-remediation readiness only.
prohibited_overreactions: Do not attribute admitted scientific defects to harness or rerooting.
Do not run W7, B3, collision, Rust, T01-T12, Radau, trajectory, endpoint, or RABBIT unblinding.
Do not alter caps, norms, grids, constants, formulas, tolerances, or claim ceilings.
Do not add another standalone readiness, manifest, hash, figure, telemetry, or policy surface.
